location_text: Allmannsdorf is a district in the east of Konstanz (postcode {{contact.address.postal_code}}). It sits on a ridge above Staad, on the right bank of the Rhine – between the city centre, the University of Konstanz and Mainau Island, close to Lake Constance.

New-build Allmannsdorf is located in this quiet, sought-after area. Many of the {{fact.units}} apartments have a view of Lake Constance. Konstanz borders directly on Kreuzlingen, so Allmannsdorf is also within easy reach for buyers from Switzerland.
